worldcombat.skill.orderup.summary: A companion gives the order and the user serves a short, flat-thrown dragon-shaped dish: the first body it touches takes one non-contact hit. With a small companion at your side it also raises one of your stats in that companion's likeness (sharing it with nearby allies in share mode). It never strips a barrier, and an empty cast still gains from a real companion.
worldcombat.skill.orderup.use.1: Raise a stat while a small companion is at your side
worldcombat.skill.orderup.use.2: Open a fight with both a strike and a buff
worldcombat.skill.orderup.description.0: The dish is thrown flat, and the first body it touches takes about %1$s non-contact damage with a %2$s block half-width; the target's Defence, type matchup and criticals are settled on the hit.
worldcombat.skill.orderup.description.1: Throw distance %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks/tick; if it touches no one the dish breaks apart at the landing point and leaves no damage.
worldcombat.skill.orderup.description.2: With an ally clearly smaller than you within %1$s blocks, you gain %2$s stage(s) of a stat in its likeness (solo mode adds one more) - Defence for a Droopy companion, Speed for a Stretchy one, Attack otherwise; in share mode the same buff also reaches up to four allies within %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.orderup.share.on: Share mode: you and up to four nearby allies each gain %1$s stage(s), at the cost of ×0.94 single-hit power and +8 ticks of cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.orderup.share.off: Solo mode: you gain one extra stage, 1.06x single-hit power and a shorter cooldown; the buff applies to you only.
worldcombat.skill.orderup.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.orderup.growth.0: From level %1$s the strike rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.orderup.growth.1: From level %1$s the strike rises to %2$s and the buff to %3$s stage(s).
worldcombat.skill.orderup.preference.sha: On: you and up to four nearby allies each gain a buff, at ×0.94 single-hit power and +8 ticks of cooldown. Off: solo mode, one extra stage for you at ×1.06 power and a shorter cooldown.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of serving. Larger values open the strike from further out.
Serve when a dish is at hand
On: prefer to serve while a small companion is at your side, turning it into a self-buff; the priority drops once that stat is nearly capped. Off: rank by threat and distance only.
